svg.title: The utilisation knee sits where the array size reaches the head dimension
svg.desc: PE utilisation against array size for three head dimensions. Utilisation falls slowly until the array size equals the head dimension, then falls steeply; doubling the head dimension moves that knee one array doubling to the right. Beneath the axis, small arrays show how much of an array of each size a head dimension of 32 can occupy.

g.text: How much of an A × A array a stage capped at D = 32 can occupy:
once A exceeds D, the extra PEs sit idle
out of memory, logged as failed

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp1_array_sensitivity/results/processed/ (exp1_summary, exp1_representative_summary, exp1_head64_validation_summary) · best per-stage static mapping
